items.statement: Operating cash flow increased to INR3,492 million in FY24 from INR2,493 million in FY23
items.quote: During the year, our operating cash flow generation remained healthy. We recorded an increase in net cash flow generation from operating activities to INR3,492 million versus INR2,493 million in FY23.

items.statement: Total net debt reduced from INR6,769 million in FY23 to INR5,707 million in FY24
items.quote: We have also reduced our debt and the total net debt has come down from INR6,769 million in FY23 to INR5,707 million in FY24.

items.statement: Provided approximately INR100 crores in FY24 for delayed payments by customers due to pending reconciliations
items.quote: We have provided approximately INR100 crores in FY24 on account of certain delays in payment by various customers due to pending reconciliations and other deductions.

items.statement: Loss allowances on trade receivables totaled INR116 crores in FY24 versus INR49 crores in FY23
items.quote: FY23 this amount was approximately around INR49 crores.

items.statement: Expect recovery of provided amounts in near future, possibly in Q2, Q3, Q4 of FY25
items.quote: I am sure we will see a good recovery happening in the near future which is maybe in quarter 2, quarter 3 and 4 definitely we will see some recovery.

items.statement: Debt maturity schedule approximately 3.5 to 4 years remaining; target to become debt-free in 4-5 years
items.quote: the debt schedule as we mentioned is approximately we have a balance maturity of around 3.5 years to 4 years approximately pending with us which will allow us to repay this debt and everything

items.statement: Cost of funds approximately 10.5% to 11%; increased by 100 basis points in last year
items.quote: Sir, cost of funds approximately in the range of around 10.5% to 11%.
